headline: DEFECT REPRODUCED, then CLOSED. A PRESERVE-everything decision on an image-logo lineage used to clear the release-blocking source-brand requirement as status='resolved' / clearedBy='output-proof' / 0 blockers while the source logotype was still in the shipped bytes. It now lands accepted-limitation / preserve-acceptance / 1 blocker. A genuine REPLACE still clears, and the linear canary's honest zero (74 hosts REPLACE, preservedAfter 0) is unchanged under a STRICTER instrument. Regression: 29 suites / 2,970 checks / 0 failures / typecheck exit 0 / 0 negative deltas (+22 vs the 2,948 baseline, all newly added).

fixes.title: preservedAfter > 0 ALWAYS yields 'preserve-acceptance', never 'output-proof' — which is the same edit as the branch-order fix
fixes.why: The adjudicator listed (i) and (iv) separately, but in this code they are one expression: testing preservedAfter FIRST is exactly what makes it ALWAYS win. Stated as a deviation only in form, not in effect — both clauses are satisfied by the single reordering, and the ordering is the load-bearing half of this whole fix: it makes the verdict independent of whether some FUTURE surface is measured yet. An unmeasured axis can now only ever downgrade a build to preserve-acceptance, never upgrade one to proof.
fixes.honestyGuard: preserve-acceptance was NOT quietly given another route to clear the blocker. It still maps to requirement.status='accepted-limitation', which releaseBlockers() still counts — verified by assertion, not by reading the code (smoke-brand-assets 28.X1, 28.X7).

Verified first: on `alt` they were ALREADY equal — both used firstBrandToken (brand-surfaces.ts:370 and brand-census.ts:81). The asymmetry the adjudicator's line references (301 vs 370) is INSIDE brand-surfaces.ts: the SAME 's src PATH is read with the identifier matcher while its alt is read with the weaker word-boundary one. So the census was not blinder than detection — the two were blind TOGETHER, which is the same hole twice, not an alignment. Both were upgraded to firstBrandTokenInIdentifier.
fixes.measuredJustification: firstBrandToken('NextjsLogotype', ['nextjs']) === undefined; firstBrandTokenInIdentifier(...) === 'nextjs'. nextjs.org ships alt="NextjsLogotype" on its logotype elements: the src path was detected as an image-logo host while the alt on the very same element was invisible to detection AND read as 0 by the census.
fixes.directionIsSafe: This is a WIDENING. It can only raise MORE surfaces, never fewer, so it cannot manufacture a clean census — the opposite of the failure mode this program exists to fix.

knownLimitationsCarried: A bake report written BEFORE this fix carries no `imageSrcPath` field, so `brand.census?.imageSrcPath ?? 0` reads it as 0 — a stored pre-fix build cannot retroactively gain the axis and would still need a REBUILD to be measured on it. This is the repo's existing 'it clears on the REBUILT OUTPUT, never on the decision' rule and is not a new hole: the `preservedAfter > 0` ordering (fix i/iv) protects such a build regardless of what its stored census says, because it does not consult the census at all.

The alt matcher widening raises nextjs.org's full-template host count from 190 to 510. That lineage is a CANARY, not an accepted production lineage, and the extra hosts are real shipped `alt="NextjsLogotype"` surfaces — but any future operator run against nextjs.org will now see 320 more decisions to make. This is the honest count, not a regression.
